newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's BNL, INA present offer for BancoNapoli.
newsitem.headline: Italy's BNL, INA present offer for BancoNapoli.

text.p: Italy's Banca Nazionale del Lavoro BNL and insurer INA said in a statement that they presented a joint offer to the Italian Treasury on Friday to buy a 60 percent stake in struggling Banco di Napoli.

BNL and INA said on Thursday that their boards had authorised the bid one day ahead of Friday's deadline to present offers to the Treasury, which has taken temporary control of the southern Italian bank.
State-owned credit institute Mediocredito Centrale also announced on Thursday it intended to make a bid.
Banco di Napoli unveiled a loss of 3.12 trillion lire for 1995, the largest loss in Italian banking history and plunged a further 674 billion lire into the red in the first half of 1996.
